name: Town Centre Gardens Play Area
description: Play area for children up to 16 in the Town Centre Gardens, reopened in March 2025 after a £250,000 refurbishment, with a bespoke pirate ship, a group swing, an activity trail, a trampoline and an inclusive roundabout. Local children chose the equipment.
